Summary

Main Deck: 30 cards · Generator: 30 Energies ⚡ · Starting hand: 5 cards (needs 1 Endo) · Active Zone: 4 Animatronics · First to 4 KOs wins.

Generator Energy ⚡

Each turn the Generator gives 1 Energy to your Pool. Energies accumulate if unused (turn 1 → 1 available, turn 2 → 2 if unspent, etc.). Attach energy to an animatronic by clicking the Pool then the slot. Energy spent in attacks goes to the Blob Pile. If an animatronic reaches 0 energy after attacking → returns to Standby.

Deck Energy Cards

○ Remnant, ● Agony and ◆ Phantom Agony are main deck cards. They are not played directly - they are consumed automatically when evolving or summoning Phantoms:

  • ○ Remnant - required to evolve Classic, Toy and Withered animatronics
  • ● Agony - required to evolve Nightmare, Jack-O, Shadow, Fredbear and Spring Bonnie
  • ◆ Phantom Agony - required to summon Phantoms (1 per summon)

Endos

Played for free from hand to the Active Zone (max 4 slots). Limit of 6 copies per deck. Available Endos:

  • Endo-01 - evolves into Classic and Withered animatronics (uses ○ Remnant)
  • Endo-02 - evolves into Toy animatronics (uses ○ Remnant)
  • Nightmare Endo - evolves into Nightmare and Jack-O (uses ● Agony)
  • Springlock Endo - evolves into Spring Bonnie or Fredbear (uses ● Agony)

Evolution

The Endo must have been on the field ≥ 1 turn (cannot evolve the turn it was played). To evolve, you need in hand: the Shell + 1 card of the correct Energy type. Play the Shell → click the compatible Endo → the Energy card is consumed automatically to the Blob Pile.

Standby vs Awake

An animatronic wakes when attached energy ⚡ ≥ its Wake Threshold (shown on the slot). Animatronics in Standby cannot attack. If it drops to 0 energy after attacking → returns to Standby.

Tools

Each animatronic can have at most 1 tool equipped. Tools are permanent and go to the Blob Pile when the animatronic is defeated.

Phantoms

Summoned by playing a Phantom Shell from hand - consumes 1 ◆ Phantom Agony card from hand automatically (no Endo needed). If Purple Guy is equipped on Spring Bonnie, summoning is free.

Spring Bonnie → Springtrap

Equip Purple Guy on Spring Bonnie. When Spring Bonnie dies (including by gambling failure), the opponent gains 1 KO but you can search your deck for Springtrap and summon it with remaining energies. Springtrap can attack the same turn.

Blob Pile

Pile of used/discarded cards. Contains ⚡ energy spent in attacks and Energy cards (○●◆) consumed in evolutions. Some cards interact with the Blob Pile - click "Blob" to view it.

End of Turn

Automatic when all Awake animatronics have attacked. Or pass manually with "End Turn".

Mulligan

If your starting hand has no Endo, it is automatically replaced (2 attempts). From the 2nd attempt on, the opponent draws 1 extra card. After 2 failed attempts, the game finds 1 Endo in the deck, places it in hand, shuffles the rest and deals 4 more cards.
